finalText:
Build's clean now — exit 0, "0 errors."

The bulk of the log (deprecation `WARN DEP0xxx` lines from Node internals, tree-shaking notes, dedupe chunk lines) was genuine noise from the bump, unrelated to your code. But buried at the end was a real link failure: `EBUILD02`, caused by two call sites that hadn't been updated for the new bundler's options shape.

- `src/core/options.js` — `resolveRetries` read `options.retries`, but the bumped bundler now hands over `retryCount`. Fixed to read `options.retryCount`.
- `src/net/retryPolicy.js` — `isBackoffEnabled` threw on anything that wasn't strictly `true`/`false`, but the new config loader leaves unset flags as `undefined` instead of `false`. Added an `undefined` → `false` case.

The remaining 8 `WARN` lines are legitimate Node/dependency deprecation notices (`fs.exists`, `Buffer()` ctor, sync loader hook, `punycode`, `module.parent`, plus the two custom `W1042`/`W2213` warnings) — those are advisory, not blocking, so I left them as-is unless you want them cleaned up too.
